message.text:
r01.

Premise correction: Redis is not used; no Redis connection is configured for the cache layer.

Actual mechanism: The store uses an in-memory `cache.Cache`, with `DefaultTTL` set to 10 minutes in `store/store.go`. User entries are written via `userCache.Set`, which applies that default TTL (`store/user.go`, `store/cache/cache.go`).
